summary: Ubuntu 20.10 (Groovy Gorilla) was released on 22 October 2020. Features: GNOME 3.38, kernel 5.8, improved Raspberry Pi support, active directory integration improvements. The gorilla symbolized strength and the 'groovy' 70s vibe. Released during the pandemic; Canonical maintained the six-month cycle.
notes: Unsupported since 2021-07-22. Kernel 5.8. Interim release with 9-month support.
